title: 04. OOP: Abstract Classes & Interfaces (ABC Deep Dive)
summary: An Abstract Base Class (ABC) is like a job description posted by a company:

sections.title: EXPLANATION (Junior Developer Level)
sections.body:
We touched ABCs briefly in Concept 06. Now we go **deep**.

An **Abstract Base Class (ABC)** is like a **job description** posted by a company:

```
JOB DESCRIPTION (ABC):
  ✅ Must know Python           ← abstract method
  ✅ Must know SQL              ← abstract method
  ✅ Must have 3+ years exp     ← abstract method
  📋 Company provides laptop   ← concrete method (given free!)
  📋 Company pays salary       ← concrete method (given free!)

CANDIDATE (Concrete Class):
  Must fulfill ALL requirements (implement all abstract methods)
  Gets company benefits (inherits concrete methods) for FREE
```

### 🔑 Key Concepts:

```
ABC             → Abstract Base Class (template/contract)
@abstractmethod → Method MUST be implemented by child
@abstractproperty → Abstract property (deprecated → use @property + @abstractmethod)
ABCMeta         → Metaclass that enforces abstract method rules
register()      → Register a class as virtual subclass of ABC
__subclasshook__ → Custom isinstance() behaviour
```

### ⚙️ Complete ABC Features:

```python
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod, ABCMeta

class MyABC(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def method(self): pass           # abstract instance method

    @classmethod
    @abstractmethod
    def class_method(cls): pass      # abstract classmethod

    @staticmethod
    @abstractmethod
    def static_method(): pass        # abstract staticmethod

    @property
    @abstractmethod
    def my_property(self): pass      # abstract property

    def concrete_method(self):       # regular method — inherited free!
        pass
```
